From: Elena Sokolov <elena@finovate.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring monthly guarantee options for hosted API

Hi Sean —

Quick intro: I lead platform integrations at Finovate AI. We're evaluating hosted inference partners for a text-generation feature going into our product in Q1. We won't be in a position to take Dedicated capacity soon, but we expect steady growth from ~10M tokens/month in month 1 to ~40M by month 6.

Before scheduling a call, can you share:
- What minimum monthly guarantee / committed-spend options do you offer for the Hosted API?
- Per-token pricing at low (0-25M), mid (25-100M), and high (>100M) tiers with and without a commit?
- Any onboarding credits, trial terms, or roll-over policies for unused commit?
- The process for procurement (POs / SOW) and expected lead time for account activation.

We are evaluating multiple vendors; we need something predictable on cost but also flexible for early stage growth. Please send a short rate-card and any standard MAP (mutual action plan) you use.

Thanks — happy to share a usage sample if helpful.

Elena
Elena Sokolov
Head of Platform Integrations, Finovate AI
elena@finovate.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Sokolov <elena@finovate.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring monthly guarantee options for hosted API

Hi Elena — great to meet you. Thanks for the clear usage profile — that helps. I'm attaching a short rate card and a draft MAP so you have something concrete to review (attached: Redwood_Ratecard_SEP2026.pdf, Draft_MAP_Finovate_Sep2026.pdf).

High level options (hosted API, no Dedicated):
1) No-commit (pay-as-you-go)
   - 0–25M tokens: $0.00055 / token
   - 25M–100M: $0.00048 / token
   - >100M: custom negotiated
   - No minimum, no prep credits, higher variability

2) Monthly guarantee (recommended for predictable unit economics)
   - $10k/month guarantee (billed monthly) — effective unit price ~ $0.00042/token at ~25M tokens equivalent; unused portion expires unless rolled into a 30-day credit at renewal
   - $25k/month guarantee — effective unit price ~ $0.00036/token at sustained 25–100M range; 1-month rollover allowed for up to 50% of unused commit
   - $50k+/month — custom pricing, includes priority capacity and 60-day rollover; eligible for longer-term volume discounts

3) Short-term pilot bridge
   - 30-day trial with $5k usage credit (hosted) to validate inference integration
   - If you convert to a monthly guarantee within 60 days, we apply a one-time onboarding credit of up to $3k depending on term length

Overage: billed at the no-commit overage rate (typically +10–15% above committed unit price).

Procurement: we accept standard POs and DocuSign SOWs. Typical activation after PO + signed MAP: 3–7 business days (longer if you need SSA/KMS onboarding).

Next steps: if you can share a 3-month token forecast and whether Finovate prefers monthly vs quarterly billing, I can model concrete SKU pricing and proposal. I'm available for a 30-min call this week.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
+1 (510) 555-0123

Thanks Sean — that's helpful. Two quick clarifying questions:
1) We're a small team; would you consider a lower entry guarantee, e.g., $7.5k/mo, with a 6-month commitment? That would help us get predictable billing while buying time to ramp.
2) Can you confirm the security onboarding items (SOC 2 report, IP protection, retention controls) and whether those are tied to the pricing tiers?

If you can provide a short example MAP with $7.5k/mo for 6 months and the delta vs $10k/mo, I'll take it to procurement. Also please flag any standard redlines on your SOW you typically see from finance teams.

Elena

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Exploring monthly guarantee options for hosted API — approval request

Looping you both in — Finovate is asking if we can support a $7.5k/mo entry guarantee for 6 months. They're small but show a clear ramp profile (10M -> 40M tokens over 6 months). They prefer hosted (no Dedicated).

My suggested concessions: 
- Offer $7.5k/mo for 6 months with effective unit price about $0.00040/token for the expected volume.
- Provide $2.5k onboarding credit applied in the first invoice if they sign a 6-month MAP.
- Overage rate set at the 10–15% premium above committed unit price.
- Security deliverables: SOC2 Type II report available on request; KMS/HSM onboarding is an add-on (not required for hosted).

Margin check: we can do this if we keep onboarding credit to $2.5k and no additional implementation hours included. If they want SSO/KMS or extended retention, that should be scoped and quoted.

Marissa — do you approve the $7.5k/6mo path and the $2.5k credit? Aditya — I can draft the MAP doc and the pricing table if you greenlight.

Thanks,
Sean

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We can support a lower entry point to help you get started. Attached is an updated MAP and the rate summary (Draft_MAP_Finovate_Sep2026.pdf, Redwood_Ratecard_SEP2026.pdf). Key points: 

- Term: 6 months (monthly billing)
- Monthly guarantee: $7,500 / month
- Expected effective unit price for your stated ramp (10M -> 40M tokens): ~ $0.00040 / token
- Onboarding credit: $2,500 (applied to first invoice upon signed MAP)
- Overage: billed at the agreed committed unit + 12%
- Rollover: up to 30% of unused commit can be applied within the next 30 days
- Security: SOC 2 Type II report available; retention controls configurable via Console; KMS/HSM onboarding is a paid add-on and not required to start

Procurement: we can execute on a simple MAP + DocuSign SOW. I'll attach the DocuSign link in a follow-up if this model looks good to you. If procurement needs a PO-first flow, we accept that and will activate once PO and signed MAP are received (3–7 business days typical).

Next steps: 1) confirm you want the 6-month $7.5k/mo path; 2) if yes, share the procurement contact and billing email; 3) I'll send the DocuSign + MAP. Happy to review the MAP on a 20-min call if useful.

Best regards,
